going_concern.quote: Accordingly, there is substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.price_reset_warrants: The exercise price, and the number of shares of Class A common stock issuable under the November Warrants, are subject to a one-time reset upon the completion of a subsequent financing transaction with gross proceeds of $2.5 million or more, subject to a floor price of $1.00 per share.
financing_terms.equity_line: The transactions were entered into at various times throughout 2024 and consisted of convertible notes, standby equity purchase agreements, private placements, existing loan modifications and warrant agreements.
